limits: Approximate Python launch windows cannot be equated with actual native event windows.
RSS/footprint changes do not identify freed allocations, recoverable cache bytes or unique physical RAM.
One initial lifecycle sequence followed by sustained live widgets is not repeated lifecycle churn.
Frame ages are acquisition ages; completion ages include measured disk work, neither is audiovisual presentation.
Lifecycle ordering is independently checked by the separate h19_lifecycle_check tool; this audit addresses all raw frame accounting and resource trends.
No leak-freedom, third-party sandbox, default Keychain, release or audiovisual-output claim.
